events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Coach Zac Taylor and the Cincinnati Bengals talked all offseason about how their defensive acquisitions would have a huge impact.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals force 4 turnovers, Burrow throws for TD in 33-27 win over the Buccaneers

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions felt fortunate to escape with a 31-30 victory in overtime over New Orleans on Sunday for at least a few reasons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions escape with 31-30 win over Saints in OT after Kellen Moore chooses to go for 2 and the win

events.name: New York Jets at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — The New York Jets made some big moves and changes during the offseason trying to shake up a franchise mired in a decade of losing.
headlines.shortLinkText: Breece Hall powers Jets past Titans 23-10 in a dominant season opener against their former coach

headlines.description: — Derrick Henry still looks ageless, and Lamar Jackson put on an MVP-like show again.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derrick Henry's rushes for 3 TDs and Lamar Jackson lights up the Colts in the Ravens' 41-23 win

headlines.description: — T.J. Watt began his 10th season by trying to move past the noise that followed his ninth.
headlines.shortLinkText: T.J. Watt's late pick-6 pushes sluggish Steelers past injury-laden Falcons 20-13

headlines.description: — Ben Johnson said he slept well Saturday night at the Bears' team hotel, sensing that quarterback Caleb Williams was more than ready for the season opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caleb Williams and Bears trounce Panthers 59-37 in highest-scoring season opener in NFL history

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence and the Jacksonville Jaguars waited seven agonizing months to play another meaningful game at EverBank Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence throws 4 TD passes as the Jaguars rout the Browns 34-10 in season opener

headlines.description: — Josh Allen didn’t wait for the question he knew was coming on Sunday after finally leading the Buffalo Bills to a road win over the Houston Texans in a season-opening thriller.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen connects with Joshua Palmer for a late TD and Bills beat Texans 36-31 in wild opener

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins was brought in to be Las Vegas' present and a bridge to a future where top draft pick
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirk Cousins hits 301 career TD passes as Raiders open the season with a 27-13 win over Dolphins

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Carson Wentz has had little time to practice with Minnesota's voluminous playbook, a late arrival to the team last season who returned this year in more of a mentor role as Kyler Murray and J.J. McCarthy competed for the starting quarterback job
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings close with 29 straight points to beat rival Packers as Wentz replaces injured Murray

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts can count on a few guarantees in each season opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts throws 3 TD passes and Eagles stuff Commanders' late 2-point try for 24-22 win

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Coming off an injury-riddled three-win season and with a new coaching staff, the Arizona Cardinals were the NFL's biggest underdog going into Week 1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals beat Chargers 26-14 as Mike LaFleur wins his head coaching debut

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Several months before coaching his first game for the New York Giants, John Harbaugh told fans he wanted to build a team that could beat...
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants' offense rolls over the Cowboys to give coach John Harbaugh a 28-20 win in his debut
